title: Thinner borders and lighter serif quote font on Gallery page

requirements.summary: Reduce border widths on the Gallery page to 1px or less
acceptanceCriteria: All visible borders / outlines on the Gallery page are thinner than in the previous version

file_operations.description: Reduce all border widths in the Gallery page component to 1px or 0.5px. Specifically target any border or outline CSS classes (e.g., border-2, border-4) and replace them with border or border-[0.5px] for an ultra-thin appearance. Review all Card, section wrapper, and decorative border elements to ensure consistent thinning across the entire Gallery page.

requirements.summary: Apply lighter serif font (Playfair Display) to quote text on Gallery page
acceptanceCriteria: The quote text on the Gallery page uses Playfair Display (or another serif font) instead of a sans-serif font
The quote text has a lighter font weight (300 or 400) compared to the previous version
The change applies only to the quote element, not other Gallery text

file_operations.description: Locate the quote text element in the Gallery page component and apply the Playfair Display serif font family (font-playfair) along with a lighter font weight (font-light for 300 or font-normal for 400). Ensure this styling change is scoped only to the quote text element and does not affect other text elements on the Gallery page. The Playfair Display font is already loaded in the project via Google Fonts.
